Root owns src/, tests/, and tools/ic_target_benchmark.py; do not edit those paths or commit.

Freeze bits [12,14,16], curve seeds [0,1,2], solver seeds [0,1], m=2, small_x, mitm, harvest=off, scalar acceleration disabled. Window=4. Use a reference A/A duplicate, alternating deterministic execution order, and matched synthetic public targets. No parameter selection from timings.

Primary metric is external complete solve wall time including final verification and full target-cache setup; retain censored or unsuccessful trials. Secondary counters and RSS must remain separately typed.
